verdict.rationale: Clara documents its own accounts-payable surface: the API handles invoices, and an `/api/v3/accounts-payable/pix` endpoint creates vendor payments that move money. That shows AP runs in the same platform, but only thinly. The approvals evidence covers expense reporting, not AP routing, and the only payment rail shown is Pix. missing for 10: invoice capture workflow details (OCR/ingestion), AP-specific approval routing, ACH/check/wire payment rails, independent or hands-on corroboration.
